Reset Database Filters Reader Services, Registration & Circulation Desk Decentralized Registration Across All Branches. Membership is free for all registered Babcock students and staff. Registration is fully decentralized: you can register right at any of the 10 branch libraries or at the Laz Otti Main Library. Mandatory Registration Requirements: Must present a valid Student or Staff I.D. card. Please note: Application number is strictly not acceptable. Students must be fully registered for the academic session to activate borrowing privileges. Decentralized Register at any of 10 campus branches 2 to 4 Books Borrowing quota based on student level Instant Clearance Graduation and semester clearance at LOML Undergraduates Postgraduates Faculty & Staff Community / External (₦500/yr) 2 Books Allowed 2 Weeks Duration Undergraduate Borrowing Entitlement Enrolled undergraduates receive 2 borrowing cards to allow them loan 2 books for 2 weeks. Provision is made for renewal after two weeks. Registration is decentralized across all host schools. • Valid across all open stacks in Laz Otti Main Library & 10 branches • Renewal available after 2 weeks if no recall is logged • Free WiFi, Mendeley/Zotero citation support, and OPAC access included Reprographic Services Affordable low-cost student printing and photocopying: Printing @ ₦50 per page and Photocopying @ ₦40 per page , plus hardcover dissertation binding. Reserve Book Service Core course textbooks with limited copies or on heavy academic demand are placed on closed reserve behind the desk. Overnight and weekend loans are available upon card deposit. Inter-Library Loans Can't find a crucial book or article? Our Inter-Library Loan service sources monographs from libraries across the globe at no cost to you , supported by the University Librarian. Complimentary Access Except for minor nominal fees for external visitors (₦500/yr) and paper reprography, library resources, databases, WiFi, reference, and training courses are entirely free.
